-- ARAM_EXPLOITS.lua
-- Full standalone LocalScript for Roblox Studio
-- Place in StarterPlayer > StarterPlayerScripts
-- Features: Blue UI, draggable window, A button, ESP, Speed slider, NoClip,
-- Floating AIMBOT [MMB], target lock until 0 HP, ignore Rat & RatCriminal.

local Players=game:GetService("Players")
local UIS=game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RS=game:GetService("RunService")
local VIM=game:GetService("VirtualInputManager")
local player=Players.LocalPlayer
local camera=workspace.CurrentCamera

-- =========================
-- ONE-SCRIPT KEY SYSTEM
-- =========================
-- Local-only key check. This is convenient for a single-script setup,
-- but it is NOT secure against someone inspecting the LocalScript.
local VALID_KEY="ARAM-2026"
local LINK="https://link-hub.net/4890633/YHGbs3YoPMqL"
local keyVerified=false

local function createKeySystem(parentGui,onUnlocked)
 local keyFrame=Instance.new("Frame",parentGui)
 keyFrame.Name="KeySystem"
 keyFrame.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(390,280)

 local keyStroke=Instance.new("UIStroke",keyFrame)

 keyStroke.Thickness=1.5

 local title=Instance.new("TextLabel",keyFrame)
 title.BackgroundTransparency=1
 title.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(20,18)
 title.Size=UDim2.new(1,-40,0,30)
 title.Text="ARAM_EXPLOITS"
 title.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold
 title.TextSize=24
 title.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(120,230,255)

 local subtitle=Instance.new("TextLabel",keyFrame)
 subtitle.BackgroundTransparency=1
 subtitle.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(20,48)
 subtitle.Size=UDim2.new(1,-40,0,24)
 subtitle.Text="KEY SYSTEM"
 subtitle.Font=Enum.Font.Gotham
 subtitle.TextSize=13
 subtitle.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(160,160,170)

 local box=Instance.new("TextBox",keyFrame)
 box.Size=UDim2.new(1,-40,0,44)
 box.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(20,84)
 box.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(35,35,40)
 box.BorderSizePixel=0
 box.ClearTextOnFocus=false
 box.PlaceholderText="Enter key..."
 box.Text=""
 box.Font=Enum.Font.Gotham
 box.TextSize=16
 box.TextColor3=Color3.new(1,1,1)
 box.PlaceholderColor3=Color3.fromRGB(100,100,110)
 box.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
 Instance.new("UICorner",box).CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,12)
 local getKey=Instance.new("TextButton",keyFrame)
 getKey.Size=UDim2.new(1,-40,0,42)
 getKey.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(20,138)
 getKey.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(40,160,255)
 getKey.BorderSizePixel=0
 getKey.Text="GET KEY"
 getKey.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold
 getKey.TextSize=15
 getKey.TextColor3=Color3.new(1,1,1)
 Instance.new("UICorner",getKey).CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,12)


 local unlock=Instance.new("TextButton",keyFrame)
 unlock.Size=UDim2.new(1,-40,0,42)
 unlock.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(20,186)
 unlock.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(40,170,40)
 unlock.BorderSizePixel=0
 unlock.Text="UNLOCK"
 unlock.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold
 unlock.TextSize=15
 unlock.TextColor3=Color3.new(1,1,1)
 Instance.new("UICorner",unlock).CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,12)

 local status=Instance.new("TextLabel",keyFrame)
 status.BackgroundTransparency=1
 status.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(20,234)
 status.Size=UDim2.new(1,-40,0,24)
 status.Text="Enter your key"
 status.Font=Enum.Font.Gotham
 status.TextSize=12
 status.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(190,190,200)

 local function tryUnlock()
  if box.Text==VALID_KEY then
   keyVerified=true
   status.Text="KEY ACCEPTED"
   status.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(80,210,100)
   task.wait(0.15)
   keyFrame.Visible=false
   if onUnlocked then
    onUnlocked()
   end
   return true
  else
   status.Text="INVALID KEY"
   status.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(220,70,70)
   box.Text=""
   box:CaptureFocus()
   return false
  end
 end

 getKey.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
  local opened=false

  pcall(function()
   local GuiService=game:GetService("GuiService")
   if GuiService and typeof(GuiService.OpenBrowserWindow)=="function" then
    GuiService:OpenBrowserWindow(LINK)
    opened=true
   end
  end)

  pcall(function()
   if setclipboard then
    setclipboard(LINK)
   end
  end)

  if opened then
   status.Text="Link opened! Complete Linkvertise to get your key."
  else
   status.Text=LINK
  end

  status.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(80,210,255)
 end)

 unlock.MouseButton1Click:Connect(tryUnlock)

 box.FocusLost:Connect(function(enterPressed)
  if enterPressed then
   tryUnlock()
  end
 end)

 -- Allow the key window to be moved with a mouse or finger.
 local dragging=false
 local dragStart=nil
 local startPos=nil

 keyFrame.Active=true

 keyFrame.InputBegan:Connect(function(i)
  if i.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
     or i.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
   dragging=true
   dragStart=i.Position
   startPos=keyFrame.Position
  end
 end)

 UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(i)
  if dragging
     and (i.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
       or i.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
   local d=i.Position-dragStart
   keyFrame.Position=UDim2.new(
    startPos.X.Scale,
    startPos.X.Offset+d.X,
    startPos.Y.Scale,
    startPos.Y.Offset+d.Y
   )
  end
 end)

 UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(i)
  if i.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
     or i.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
   dragging=false
  end
 end)

 return keyFrame
end

-- Responsive UI sizing
local BASE_UI_WIDTH=720
local MIN_UI_SCALE=0.65
local MAX_UI_SCALE=1.35

local function updateResponsiveUI()
 local scale=math.clamp(
  frame.AbsoluteSize.X/BASE_UI_WIDTH,
  MIN_UI_SCALE,
  MAX_UI_SCALE
 )

 -- Keep the two columns balanced as the menu is resized.
 leftColumn.Size=UDim2.new(0.49,-5,1,0)
 rightColumn.Position=UDim2.new(0.51,5,0,0)
 rightColumn.Size=UDim2.new(0.49,-5,1,0)

 -- Switch rows.
 for _,btn in ipairs({espBtn,aimBtn,autoBiteBtn,noclipBtn}) do
  local cardFrame=btn.Parent
  if cardFrame then
   cardFrame.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,50*scale)
   btn.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(70*scale,30*scale)
   btn.Position=UDim2.new(1,-80*scale,.5,-15*scale)

   local label=cardFrame:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("TextLabel")
   if label then
    label.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(15*scale,0)
    label.TextSize=16*scale
   end
  end
 end

 -- Speed row.
 speedCard.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,75*scale)
 speedText.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(15*scale,8*scale)
 speedText.Size=UDim2.new(1,-30*scale,0,20*scale)
 speedText.TextSize=16*scale

 bar.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(15*scale,42*scale)
 bar.Size=UDim2.new(1,-30*scale,0,10*scale)

 fill.Size=UDim2.new(fill.Size.X.Scale,0,1,0)

 knob.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(18*scale,18*scale)
 knob.Position=UDim2.new(fill.Size.X.Scale,-9*scale,.5,-9*scale)

 -- Action rows.
 for _,cardFrame in ipairs({cheeseCard,keycardCard,escapedRatCard,scientistCard}) do
  if cardFrame then
   cardFrame.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,50*scale)
  end
 end

 for _,btn in ipairs({cheeseBtn,keycardBtn,escapedRatBtn,scientistBtn}) do
  btn.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(10*scale,5*scale)
  btn.Size=UDim2.new(1,-20*scale,1,-10*scale)
  btn.TextSize=(btn==escapedRatBtn or btn==scientistBtn) and 13*scale or 15*scale
 end

 -- TELEPORT heading.
 teleportHeader.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,24*scale)
 teleportSection.TextSize=18*scale
 teleportWarning.TextSize=11*scale
end

  local d=i.Position-resizeStart

  local newWidth=math.clamp(
   startSize.X+d.X,

   math.max(300,workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize.X-20)
  )

  local newHeight=math.clamp(
   startSize.Y+d.Y,
   300,
   math.max(350,workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize.Y-20)
  )

  frame.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(newWidth,newHeight)
  updateResponsiveUI()
 end
end)

UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(i)
 if i.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
    or i.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
  resizing=false
 end
end)

-- Speed slider
local sliding=false
local speedConnections={}

local function disconnectSpeedConnections()
 for _,connection in ipairs(speedConnections) do
  if connection then
   connection:Disconnect()
  end
 end
 table.clear(speedConnections)
end

local function applySpeed(h)
 if h and h.Parent then
  h.WalkSpeed=speedValue
 end
end

local function setupHumanoidSpeed(c)
 disconnectSpeedConnections()

 local h=c:WaitForChild("Humanoid")

 -- Apply the saved value immediately after spawning.
 applySpeed(h)

 -- Keep the selected value when something in the game changes WalkSpeed.
 -- This is for the user's own game; the server should still be the authority
 -- for any intended gameplay limits.
 table.insert(speedConnections,h:GetPropertyChangedSignal("WalkSpeed"):Connect(function()
  if h.WalkSpeed~=speedValue then
   applySpeed(h)
  end
 end))
end

local function updateSpeedSliderFromX(x)
 x=math.clamp(x,0,1)
 speedValue=math.max(1,math.floor(x*100))

 fill.Size=UDim2.new(x,0,1,0)
 knob.Position=UDim2.new(x,-9,.5,-9)
 speedText.Text="Speed : "..speedValue

 local c=player.Character
 local h=c and c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
 applySpeed(h)
end

bar.InputBegan:Connect(function(i)
 if i.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
  sliding=true

  local x=(i.Position.X-bar.AbsolutePosition.X)/bar.AbsoluteSize.X
  updateSpeedSliderFromX(x)
 end
end)

knob.InputBegan:Connect(function(i)

  sliding=false

  local c=player.Character
  local h=c and c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
  applySpeed(h)
 end

local function findCheeseTrays()

 for _,obj in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do

   -- to a nearby part/model rather than directly inside the tray.
   if not prompt then
    local parent=obj.Parent
    for _=1,4 do
     if not parent then break end
     prompt=parent:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ProximityPrompt",true)
     if prompt then break end
     parent=parent.Parent
    end

   local targetCFrame=nil

   if obj:IsA("BasePart") then

   elseif obj:IsA("Model") then
    targetCFrame=obj:GetPivot()

     cframe=targetCFrame

   end
  end
 end

 return trays

local function getTeleportCFrame(obj)
 if obj:IsA("BasePart") then
  return obj.CFrame
 elseif obj:IsA("Model") then
  return obj:GetPivot()
 elseif obj:IsA("Attachment") then
  return obj.WorldCFrame
 end

 local parts={}
 for _,desc in ipairs(obj:GetDescendants()) do
  if desc:IsA("BasePart") then
   table.insert(parts,desc)
  end
 end

 if #parts==0 then
  return nil
 end

 local minX,maxX=math.huge,-math.huge
 local minY,maxY=math.huge,-math.huge
 local minZ,maxZ=math.huge,-math.huge

 for _,part in ipairs(parts) do
  local half=part.Size*0.5
  local p=part.Position

  minX=math.min(minX,p.X-half.X)
  maxX=math.max(maxX,p.X+half.X)
  minY=math.min(minY,p.Y-half.Y)
  maxY=math.max(maxY,p.Y+half.Y)
  minZ=math.min(minZ,p.Z-half.Z)
  maxZ=math.max(maxZ,p.Z+half.Z)
 end

 return CFrame.new(
  (minX+maxX)*0.5,
  (minY+maxY)*0.5,
  (minZ+maxZ)*0.5
 )
end

local function closestTarget()
 local c=player.Character

 if not root then return nil end

 for _,p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
  if p~=player and p.Character and not isIgnoredAimbotTeam(p) then
   local hrp=p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

	page.ScrollBarThickness = 3
	page.ScrollBarImageColor3 = Theme.Accent

	pageLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 8)

	local pagePadding = Instance.new("UIPadding")
	pagePadding.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 6)
	pagePadding.Parent = page

			TweenService:Create(data.Btn, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {BackgroundColor3 = Theme.ItemBg}):Play()
			TweenService:Create(data.Icon, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {ImageColor3 = Theme.SubText}):Play()
			TweenService:Create(data.Text, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {TextColor3 = Theme.SubText}):Play()
		end

		TweenService:Create(tabBtn, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Accent}):Play()
		TweenService:Create(tabIcon, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {ImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 15)}):Play()

			TweenService:Create(tabBtn, TweenInfo.new(0.15), {BackgroundColor3 = Theme.ItemBg}):Play()
		end
	end)

	if FirstTab then
		FirstTab = false
		page.Visible = true
		tabBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Accent
		tabIcon.ImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 15)
		tabText.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 15)
	end

	return page
end

local function AddSlider(parent, text, min, max, default, callback)

	local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
	frame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 48)

	local valLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")

	valLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	valLabel.Text = tostring(value)
	valLabel.TextColor3 = Theme.Accent
	valLabel.Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
	valLabel.TextSize = 12
	valLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
	valLabel.Parent = frame

	local barBg = Instance.new("Frame")
	barBg.Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 6)
	barBg.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 32)
	barBg.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(18, 18, 24)
	barBg.Parent = frame

	local bCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	bCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
	bCorner.Parent = barBg

	local fill = Instance.new("Frame")
	fill.Size = UDim2.new((value - min) / (max - min), 0, 1, 0)
	fill.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Accent
	fill.Parent = barBg

	local fCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	fCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
	fCorner.Parent = fill

	local isDragging = false
	local function UpdateSlider(input)
		local pos = math.clamp((input.Position.X - barBg.AbsolutePosition.X) / barBg.AbsoluteSize.X, 0, 1)
		value = math.floor(min + ((max - min) * pos))
		valLabel.Text = tostring(value)
		
		TweenService:Create(fill, TweenInfo.new(0.05, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
			Size = UDim2.new(pos, 0, 1, 0)
		}):Play()
		
		pcall(function() callback(value) end)
	end

	barBg.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			isDragging = true
			UpdateSlider(input)
		end
	end)

	UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			isDragging = false
		end
	end)

	UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if isDragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
			UpdateSlider(input)
		end
	end)
end

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)

    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.W then ctrl.f = 1 end
    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.S then ctrl.b = -1 end

    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.D then ctrl.r = 1 end
end)

    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.W then ctrl.f = 0 end
    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.S then ctrl.b = 0 end
    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.A then ctrl.l = 0 end
    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.D then ctrl.r = 0 end
end)

-- Sistema estável de braços fechados
local function setArmsClosed(character)
    if not character then return end
    local ls = character:FindFirstChild("LeftShoulder", true) or character:FindFirstChild("Left Shoulder", true)
    local rs = character:FindFirstChild("RightShoulder", true) or character:FindFirstChild("Right Shoulder", true)
    if ls and rs then
        ls.Transform = CFrame.new(-0.2, -0.2, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(-5))
        rs.Transform = CFrame.new(0.2, -0.2, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(5))
    end
end

-- Motor Principal de Voo 3D Livre Relativo à Câmera
local function startFly()
    local character = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not character or not character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then return end
    local hrp = character.HumanoidRootPart
    local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    
    if humanoid then
        humanoid.PlatformStand = true
    end
    
    -- Inicializa instâncias físicas estáveis
    bg = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
    bg.maxTorque = Vector3.new(9e9, 9e9, 9e9)
    bg.P = 9e4
    bg.cframe = hrp.CFrame
    bg.Parent = hrp
    
    bv = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
    bv.maxForce = Vector3.new(9e9, 9e9, 9e9)
    bv.velocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
    bv.Parent = hrp
    
    -- Vincula o voo ao ciclo de renderização físico estável do Roblox
    flyConnection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        if not flying or not character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then return end
        
        setArmsClosed(character)
        bg.cframe = Camera.CFrame
        
        -- Se houver movimento nas teclas W,A,S,D calcula vetor 3D perfeito pela mira
        if ctrl.f + ctrl.b ~= 0 or ctrl.l + ctrl.r ~= 0 then
            bv.velocity = ((Camera.CFrame.LookVector * (ctrl.f + ctrl.b)) + (Camera.CFrame.RightVector * (ctrl.l + ctrl.r))).Unit * flySpeed
        else
            bv.velocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
        end
        
        -- Injeção Física Direta contra Dano de Queda (Bypass NDS Completo)
        if humanoid then
            humanoid.SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown, false)
            humanoid.SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll, false)
            pcall(function()
                hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = bv.velocity
            end)
        end
    end)
end

local function stopFly()
    flying = false
    if flyConnection then flyConnection:Disconnect() flyConnection = nil end
    if bg then bg:Destroy() end
    if bv then bv:Destroy() end
    
    local character = LocalPlayer.Character
    if character then
        local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if humanoid then
            humanoid.PlatformStand = false
            humanoid.SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown, true)
            humanoid.SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll, true)
            humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running)
        end
        local hrp = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if hrp then hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0) end
    end
end

-- Alternar Estado
local function toggleFly()
    flying = not flying
    if flying then
        ToggleButton.Text = "LIGADO (E)"
        ToggleButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 175, 105) -- Verde moderno
        startFly()
    else
        ToggleButton.Text = "DESLIGADO (E)"

        stopFly()
    end
end

local function update(input)
	local delta = input.Position - dragStart
	mainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
end

		end)

			}
			
			-- Standard format for custom Decal IDs: "rbxassetid://" .. inputId

			-- Target RemoteEvent tracking

					-- Visual success feedback

					task.wait(1)

				else

				end

		end
	else

	end

BARRAGE - [ALIENS] Rope an Animal

Update Log & Feature List (2026-09-27)

FEATURE EXCLUSIVES & BYPASSES





Core Catching, Riding & Progression Bypasses:





Lasso Teleport: Teleports directly beside the best-paying animal on any island and throws the game’s own lasso. Follow-up throws use the server’s response timing down to a 0.45-second floor instead of the normal 1.25-second client lock.



Lasso Aura: Lets Stay In Place rope any animal already within lasso range without moving your character.



Auto Steer: Automatically steers every ride, including manual rides, toward the finish line where Guardians stop while sidestepping obstacles along the way.



Teleport Home Mid-Ride: Optional ride bypass that asks the game to teleport you home while still riding. If the server keeps the ride active, it automatically falls back to normal riding for the rest of the session.



Remote Pad Claim: Claims pad income remotely by activating each claim plate from anywhere, only moving to the pad if the server requires proximity.



Instant Power Boost: Instantly answers every 2x Power popup as soon as it appears so boost windows do not time out.



Player Mods: Includes Speed beyond your normal Speed cap, Fly, Noclip, Jump Boost, and Infinite Jump.

CATCHING & RIDE AUTOMATION





Auto Catch:





Auto Catch: Fully automates animal catching with keybind support. Features Presets (Smart Progression, Safe Only, Lasso Aura, Rare Hunter), Catch Actions (Lasso Wild Animals, Steal Player Rides, Stay In Place), Target (Best Income, Heaviest, Nearest), Island Rule (Smart, Safe Only, Any Island), selectable Catch Islands, and configurable Catch Delay.



Smart Island Selection: Uses every island where your Speed can outrun the Guardian plus the next island up. If a Guardian catches you, that island is temporarily skipped until your Speed increases.



Auto Ride:





Auto Ride: Automatically completes captured rides using Presets (Finish Line, Teleport Home), Ride Actions (Sidestep When Stuck, Teleport Home), Ride To (Finish Line, My Base), and configurable Stuck Time.

PEN & COLLECTION





Auto Pen:





Auto Pen: Automatically manages captured animals using Presets (Everything, Equip Best Only) and Pen Actions (Equip Best, Place Held Animals), with a configurable Pen Delay.



Auto Collect:





Auto Collect: Automatically collects pad income using Presets (Blatant, Level Up Too, Relaxed) and Collect Actions (Claim Pads, Level Up Pad Animals), with configurable Claim At based on stored seconds of income.

SELLING





Auto Sell:





Auto Sell: Automatically sells unwanted animals with keybind support using Presets (Keep Best, Sell Spares, Low Islands), configurable Keep rules (Alien Craft Materials, Better Than Pads, Mutations), selectable Sell Islands, and Keep Top.

MOVEMENT





Movement:





Movement: Automated navigation using Presets (Blatant, Legit, Walk) and Movement Mode (Teleport, Tween, Walk), with Teleport as the default. Includes adjustable Tween Speed and Walk Speed.

PROGRESSION





Auto Upgrade:





Auto Upgrade: Automatically manages progression using Presets (Smart Progression, Speed First, Pads First) and Upgrade Actions (Buy Treadmills, Equip Best Treadmill, Upgrade Base). Includes configurable Upgrade Order and Coin Reserve.



Auto Train:





Auto Train: Automatically keeps training active using Presets (Always, Between Catches) and Train Actions (Hold While Catching), with adjustable Re-Equip Delay.
